_meta.drinkFormula: mood = drink_mood, energy = drink_energy, xp = drink_xp

abbasid_ribs.label: Abbasid Ribs
abbasid_ribs.desc: Succulent Abbasid ribs, made using a time-honored Abbasidian recipe.

abbasidose.label: Abbasidose
abbasidose.desc: A compound made out of red, green and blue elements.

ace_of_spades.label: Ace of Spades
ace_of_spades.desc: Finely honed from old metal, the Ace of Spades is made for the heavy digger. Some say it's overkill, but anyone who dreams of spending another perfect day ruling the world of diggery with an iron fist, this is the ideal purchase, lemme tell you.

alchemical_tongs.label: Alchemical Tongs
alchemical_tongs.desc: Handy bendy Alchemical Tongs help you to create exciting metals like Tin, Copper and Molybdenum by adding elements to boring old hot smelted metal.

all_spice.label: Allspice
all_spice.desc: Some basic spice, freshly harvested from a Spice Plant.

alphose.label: Alphose
alphose.desc: A compound made out of red, green and blue.

apple.label: Apple
apple.desc: A boldly red and brazenly juicy apple.

applejack.label: Applejack
applejack.desc: A bowl of apple-y, oat-y, cinnamon-y applejack. Yummy hot or cold.

awesome_pot.label: Awesome Pot
awesome_pot.desc: An awesome pot is used to make special dishes. Very special.

awesome_stew.label: Awesome Stew
awesome_stew.desc: Chunky awesome stew, so thick you can eat it with a spork.

bag_furniture_cabinet.label: Cabinet
bag_furniture_cabinet.desc: The kind of unassuming cabinet that looks so plain and basic you suspect it may contain a portal to a secret world, rather than shelves. It contains shelves.

bag_furniture_sdb.label: Storage Display Box
bag_furniture_sdb.desc: For the pragmatic showoff in everyone, a box with hidden depths. Not only can you display your prized possessions, but you can tuck a virtually infinite amount of the exact same prized possession behind it, for safekeeping.

bag_furniture_smallcabinet.label: Small Cabinet
bag_furniture_smallcabinet.desc: Rumour has it this cabinet, perceived as 'small' from the outside, is actually cavernous inside, and potentially capable of time travel. The rumours are false.

bag_furniture_wallcabinet.label: Wall Cabinet
bag_furniture_wallcabinet.desc: The good thing about this cabinet is that it's at eye-level. The bad thing about it is that it's eye-level and mildly unattractive. Still, you don't need to compliment the cabinetry while you're stashing your stockpile, as they say.

banana_no_names.label: Banana No-Names
banana_no_names.desc: One banana fried to crispy, buttery perfection and drizzled with honey. Mmmm.

barnacle.label: Mortar Barnacle
barnacle.desc: If clinging to things is a skill, this little fella was a champion. Once prised from a cluster (or "Blister") of pals, Barnacles can be introduced to the Grinder to find a new purpose.

barnacle_talc.label: Barnacle Talc
barnacle_talc.desc: The post-Grinder form of the lovable barnacle, this smooth off-white powder is bound to be good for something. If only you knew what…

batterfly_bar.label: Batterfly Bounty Booster Bar
batterfly_bar.desc: An extremely potent concoction which is rumored to produce a prodigious amount of guano from a Batterfly.

beaker.label: Beaker
beaker.desc: A state-of-the-art beaker, integral for converting compounds into powders. Now available in exciting Pyrex, specifically designed for today's modern clumsy alchemist.

beam.label: Beam
beam.desc: One sturdy construction beam, similar in heft and girth to a mighty Wood Tree. But then, this Beam was once some Posts; Posts made from Boards, which in turn were once a whole shedload of Planks, each hand-culled from a tender young Wood Tree. Good thing those Wood Trees didn't die in vain, eh?

bean_bean.label: Bean Tree Bean
bean_bean.desc: A plain, non-magical bean tree bean. It can grow even more beans!

bean_bubble.label: Bubble Tree Bean
bean_bubble.desc: A fizzy bubble tree bean. It can be planted to grow a bubble tree.

bean_egg.label: Egg Plant Bean
bean_egg.desc: A smooth, round egg plant bean. It can grow egg plants. Then the fun really starts!

bean_fruit.label: Fruit Tree Bean
bean_fruit.desc: An ordinary fruit tree bean. It can be used to grow a fruit tree.

bean_gas.label: Gas Plant Bean
bean_gas.desc: A vapourous gas plant bean. It can be used to grow a gas plant.

bean_plain.label: Bean
bean_plain.desc: A bean. It can be used for cooking, or it can be seasoned to turn it into seeds for different trees and plants.

bean_seasoner.label: Bean Seasoner
bean_seasoner.desc: A Bean Seasoner seasons beans. You probably guessed that already.

bean_spice.label: Spice Plant Bean
bean_spice.desc: A small spicy bean. It can be used to plant a spice plant.

bean_wood.label: Wood Tree Bean
bean_wood.desc: A satisfyingly woody wood tree bean. You can use this to grow a wood tree. Guaranteed 100% splinter-free!

beer.label: Beer
beer.desc: A shiny can of mmm... beer.

berry_bowl.label: Berry Bowl
berry_bowl.desc: A very merry bowl of berries.

beryl.label: Chunk of Beryl
beryl.desc: Halfway between sparkly and dull, it's an innocuous chunk of beryl.

best_bean_dip.label: Best Bean Dip
best_bean_dip.desc: Bowl of beany, dippy bean dip.

big_salad.label: Big Salad
big_salad.desc: It's bigger than small. It's a big salad.

birch_candy.label: Birch Candy
birch_candy.desc: Candy made of boiled birch syrup so concentrated and so sweet that one too many and you may see god. Or at least the tooth fairy. And they'll be crying.

birch_syrup.label: Birch Syrup
birch_syrup.desc: A bottle of sticky birch syrup.

black_pepper.label: Black Pepper
black_pepper.desc: A mound of extra-sneezy black pepper.

blender.label: Blender
blender.desc: A Blender is very good for blending juices, smoothies and other concoctions. This seems a generally sturdy model.

blockmaker.label: Blockmaker
blockmaker.desc: Even simple building blocks have to come from somewhere... and this is where. Learn to harness the power of this machine and Urth Blocks of superiour blockiness shall be yours.

board.label: Board
board.desc: A solid wooden board, reminiscent of some kind of ginormous Plank – unsurprisingly, since that's what it's made of.

broccoli.label: Broccoli
broccoli.desc: One floret of unabashedly healthy broccoli.

bubble_and_squeak.label: Bubble and Squeak
bubble_and_squeak.desc: Meaty, carroty, potato-y mush, fried to perfection.

bubble_tuner.label: Bubble Tuner
bubble_tuner.desc: A Bubble Tuner somehow converts plain bubbles into not-plain bubbles. How? Nobody knows.

bulb.label: Bulb
bulb.desc: The glowy bit of a lamp. Without this, a lamp is just a stick with a silly hat on.

bunch_of_grapes.label: Bunch of Grapes
bunch_of_grapes.desc: A heaping handful of red grapes.

butterfly_butter.label: Butterfly Butter
butterfly_butter.desc: Butterfly butter might seem like an odd thing, but it is used in many delicious cooking recipes.

butterfly_egg.label: Butterfly Egg
butterfly_egg.desc: An egg seasoned with the specific mix of lepidopteral herbs and spices to hatch a Caterpillar.

butterfly_milker.label: Butterfly Milker
butterfly_milker.desc: A mechanized butterfly milker. It will gently milk your butterflies in your absence. Good for busy farmers or those with chapped hands.

cabbage.label: Cabbage
cabbage.desc: A head of tender, delicately pungent cabbage.

camphor.label: Camphor
camphor.desc: A small pile of bitter camphor.

cardamom.label: Cardamom
cardamom.desc: A generous pinch of zesty cardamom. A little goes a long way.

carobish_treats.label: Raw Bio-Organic Carob-ish Treat
carobish_treats.desc: A chewy, crunchy, apparently ethically-sourced, gritty 'candy-alternative' with a whiff of winter. Leaves a unique chocolatey aftertang you can't quite put your finger on.

cauldron.label: Cauldron
cauldron.desc: A charmed pot for potioneers of all levels. This thick, heavy, magic-imbued cauldron is perfect for potions, from novice concoctions to expert unctions.

cedar_plank_salmon.label: Cedar Plank Salmon
cedar_plank_salmon.desc: A wild salmon cooked on a wild cedar plank.

cheese.label: Cheese
cheese.desc: A nice wedge of holey cheese.

cheese_stinky.label: Stinky Cheese
cheese_stinky.desc: A lump of cheese that's been left to stand around for a while. It's what the French call 'ripe'. You could age it longer, but glory only knows what the French would call it then.

cheese_very_stinky.label: Very Stinky Cheese
cheese_very_stinky.desc: Smelling like a manatee bathed in celery juice and old surgical stockings,  goodness knows what would happen if you aged this connoisseurial cheese any longer. You could give it a go, though…

cheese_very_very_stinky.label: Very, Very Stinky Cheese
cheese_very_very_stinky.desc: This is the very, very stinkiest cheese you've ever seen, or it would be if you could see through the thick veil of tears it's inducing. You can't make this any stinkier. It wouldn't be fair to everyone else.

cheezy_sauce.label: Cheezy Sauce
cheezy_sauce.desc: A crock full of pleasingly, teasingly cheezy sauce.

cherry.label: Cherry
cherry.desc: A basic cherry, freshly picked from a Fruit Tree.

chicken_egg.label: Chicken Egg
chicken_egg.desc: An egg treated with special poultry seasoning to hatch a Chick.

chillybusting_chili.label: Chilly-Busting Chili
chillybusting_chili.desc: A tureen of fiery chilly-busting chili.

choice_crudites.label: Choice Crudites
choice_crudites.desc: A platter of the very finest crudites.

cinnamon.label: Cinnamon
cinnamon.desc: About a spoonful of versatile cinnamon.

cloud_11_smoothie.label: Cloud 11 Smoothie
cloud_11_smoothie.desc: A Cloud 11 smoothie. Pretty much the best smoothie ever invented in the history of smoothies.

cloudberry_daiquiri.label: Cloudberry Daiquiri
cloudberry_daiquiri.desc: A nourishing cloudberry daiquiri. It goes down smooth.

cloudberry_jam.label: Cloudberry Jam
cloudberry_jam.desc: A jar of tart cloudberry jam.

cocktail_shaker.label: Cocktail Shaker
cocktail_shaker.desc: A shiny, chrome-plated cocktail shaker for making special drinks.

coffee.label: Coffee
coffee.desc: A steaming mug of strong, life-affirming coffee.

common_crudites.label: Common Crudites
common_crudites.desc: Everyday crudites served in an easy-to-carry cup.

construction_tool.label: Construction Tool
construction_tool.desc: One handy pocketsized gadget for all your furniture construction needs. Comes complete with four pokey whojamaflilps, one specializing in tweaking the wotsit, one in cranking the doodah, and the other two in levering the begiantus out of any sticky-outty bits. A true professional's tool.

copper.label: Copper Ingot
copper.desc: Pliable yet strong, malleably magnificent, copper is a much-prized material for building. A glitch bearing good, strong copper will always be welcome on a building project.

corn.label: Corn
corn.desc: Many kernels of sweet corn, conveniently located on a sturdy cob.

corn_off_the_cob.label: Corn-off-the-Cob
corn_off_the_cob.desc: All the goodness of corn-on-the-cob, without the cob.

corn_syrup_squares.label: Hi-Sucrose Corn Syrup Square
corn_syrup_squares.desc: Densely-packed brick of pure brain-melting sweetness, proving that sometimes the sum of many food items is either something that is only fit for use as building material in a fairy unicorn happy-palace, or a candy.

cosmox.label: Cosmox
cosmox.desc: A compound made out of red, blue and shiny.

creamy_catsup.label: Creamy Catsup
creamy_catsup.desc: One gallon of the creamiest catsup in all the land.

crying_gas.label: Crying Gas
crying_gas.desc: A flask of crying gas, saltily infused with real tears.

crystallizer.label: Crystalmalizing Chamber
crystallizer.desc: With this tool, every armchair alchemist can be the master of their own future. Or at least make some Plain Crystals. Who knew Barnacle Talc and essence of Firefly would combine to make such fine new age bling?

cumin.label: Cumin
cumin.desc: A heap of pleasantly aromatic cumin.

curry.label: Curry
curry.desc: A top-secret blend of curry powder.

death_to_veg.label: Death to Veg
death_to_veg.desc: For those who wish a violent end to all harmless vegetables, and desire to feast upon their flesh.

desssert_rub.label: Desssert Rub
desssert_rub.desc: Gritty, sandlike, and strangely sweet, this is both sandy like the desert, and sweet like dessert, and, as such, has the s's of both.

diabolic_acid.label: Diabolic Acid
diabolic_acid.desc: A compound made out of red, green and blue.

dullite.label: Chunk of Dullite
dullite.desc: A hefty chunk of dullite. What it lacks in sparkliness it makes up for in, um, dullness.

earth.label: Lump of Earth
earth.desc: Many have tried to sum up the wonder of Earth, with superlatives like "Earthy", "Lumpy" and "Eart... oh, that's been said? Brown, then." But it's just a lump of earth. For building with.

egg_plain.label: Egg
egg_plain.desc: A plain, unseasoned egg, newly harvested from an Egg Plant. It can be used for all kinds of cooking, or it can be hatched into different animals.

egg_seasoner.label: Egg Seasoner
egg_seasoner.desc: An Egg Seasoner is an important tool for seasoning and incubating eggs that hatch into all kinds of exciting animals.

eggy_scramble.label: Eggy Scramble
eggy_scramble.desc: A messily scrumptious pile of eggs.

element_blue.label: Blue Element
element_blue.desc: An element is the basic building block of all stuff. This one is blue.

element_green.label: Green Element
element_green.desc: An element is the basic building block of all stuff. This one is green.

element_red.label: Red Element
element_red.desc: An element is the basic building block of all stuff. This one is red.

element_shiny.label: Shiny Element
element_shiny.desc: An element is the basic building block of all stuff. This one is shiny.

essence_of_gandlevery.label: Essence of Gandlevery
essence_of_gandlevery.desc: A potent distillation of Gandlevery, as rich in protein and good for energy as it is foul on the tongue and bad for mood.

essence_of_hairball.label: Essence of Hairball
essence_of_hairball.desc: All the speed-giving power of the Hairball Flower, scraped from the individual hairball ball-hairs, and concentrated into a tincture.

essence_of_purple.label: Essence of Purple
essence_of_purple.desc: You thought Purple was purple? This is seriously purple. Seriously: The purplest.

essence_of_rookswort.label: Essence of Rookswort
essence_of_rookswort.desc: Distilled Rookswort harnesses the power of the ancients for ultra-absorbent protection during those heavy rook attacks.

essence_of_rubeweed.label: Essence of Rubeweed
essence_of_rubeweed.desc: The purest scent of gullible luck, boiled down to the point where Rubes can smell it from many many planks away.

essence_of_silvertongue.label: Essence of Silvertongue
essence_of_silvertongue.desc: The concentrated charm of Silvertongue, giving large returns on upcoming ventures.

essence_of_yellow_crumb.label: Essence of Yellow Crumb
essence_of_yellow_crumb.desc: Purest concentration, concentrated, for those who need a more expansive brain-span.

exotic_fruit_salad.label: Exotic Fruit Salad
exotic_fruit_salad.desc: An enticing array of exotic fruits.

exotic_juice.label: Exotic Juice
exotic_juice.desc: A goblet of mysteriously yummy exotic juice.

expensive_grilled_cheese.label: Expensive Grilled Cheese
expensive_grilled_cheese.desc: Expensive cheese expensively grilled on expensive bread.

extremely_hallowed_shrine_powder.label: Extremely Hallowed Shrine Powder
extremely_hallowed_shrine_powder.desc: A jar of extremely hallowed shrine powder. It lets the giants know that, when it comes to currying favor, you really mean business.

face_smelter.label: Face Smelter
face_smelter.desc: A powerful brew with a scent acrid enough to perm your nostril hairs.

fairly_hallowed_shrine_powder.label: Fairly Hallowed Shrine Powder
fairly_hallowed_shrine_powder.desc: Curry a moderate amount of favor with the giants with a jar of fairly hallowed shrine powder.

fancy_pick.label: Fancy Pick
fancy_pick.desc: A super-deluxe fancy pick for fancy miners. Okay, maybe it doesn't look that fancy on the outside. It's the inside that counts.

fertilidust.label: Fertilidust
fertilidust.desc: A jar of chokingly musty fertilidust, effective in promoting the health of trees.

fertilidust_lite.label: Fertilidust Lite
fertilidust_lite.desc: A jar of somewhat musty fertilidust lite, effective in improving the health of individual trees.

fiber.label: Fiber
fiber.desc: A patch of downy hair brushed from the tail of a fox, perfect for spinning into thread or stuffing into furniture for padding.  Also might be perfect for gluing to your face as a moustache, but due to its origin (the underside of a fox tail), no one does.

firefly_jar.label: Firefly Jar
firefly_jar.desc: This is no ordinary jar. Well, it IS, but once filled with fireflies (seven maximum: objects in space need room to fly) just looking at it gives you a great sense of serenity.

flummery.label: Flummery
flummery.desc: Few things in this life are as tasty as a masterfully prepared flummery. "Just like Mom used to make!" you might say. If you had a mom, that is.

fortifying_gruel.label: Fortifying Gruel
fortifying_gruel.desc: One bowl of lumpy fortifying gruel.

fried_noodles.label: Fried Noodles
fried_noodles.desc: A small slippery hill of fried noodles.

fried_rice.label: Fried Rice
fried_rice.desc: A bowl of fried rice with lots of nummy bits.

friendly_acid.label: Friendly Acid
friendly_acid.desc: A compound made out of red and blue.

frog_in_a_hole.label: Frog-in-a-Hole
frog_in_a_hole.desc: A perfect egg perfectly fried in a perfect hole in a slice of bread.

fruit_changing_machine.label: Fruit Changing Machine
fruit_changing_machine.desc: A triple-carbine fruit-changing machine. It will transmogrify cherries into other fruit. This can come in surprisingly handy.

fruity_juice.label: Fruity Juice
fruity_juice.desc: A glass of nigh-ambrosial fruit juice.

frying_pan.label: Frying Pan
frying_pan.desc: A useful pan for frying things in.

fuel_cell.label: Fuel Cell
fuel_cell.desc: Hundreds of tiny power-pellets in each capsule provide gigajoules of energy to fuel the machines.

fuelmaker.label: Fuelmaker
fuelmaker.desc: Talk about green energy. There's so much green in these fuel cells, and the Fuelmaker is how it gets there.

furniture_armchair.label: Armchair
furniture_armchair.desc: A basic armchair. Like a normal chair, but armed. Armed and dangerous. If by "dangerous" you mean "quite uncomfortable."

furniture_bed.label: Bed
furniture_bed.desc: Where the magic happens (low-grade magic. Better magic available with upgraded beds. Also: magic not included).

furniture_bench.label: Bench
furniture_bench.desc: Too thin to be a coffee table, too low to be a shelf, too long-winded to be a stool, this is a bench. For benching people.

furniture_ceilingdeco.label: Hanging Decoration
furniture_ceilingdeco.desc: As a piece of modern art, this cutting edge contemporary faux-rustic hanging piece has been called both "a searing socio-religious commentary" and "a ceilingular carbuncle". Which is it? You decide.

furniture_ceilinglamp.label: Ceiling Lamp
furniture_ceilinglamp.desc: A small fixture, radiating with an unexplainable dim glow, like the tiny weak sun around which the universe of your house revolves.

furniture_chair.label: Chair
furniture_chair.desc: The perfect chair for those who like the idea of sitting briefly and with utmost caution. Upgrading recommended for those who like highfalutin' ideas like "comfort" and "aesthetics".

furniture_coffeetable.label: Coffee Table
furniture_coffeetable.desc: A starter table for those who enjoy the concept of resting their brew on an almost flat surface. For those who dream of an *actually* flat one, upgrades are available.

furniture_counter.label: Counter
furniture_counter.desc: Why own a counter? Because it is an admirably flat surface, useful for dividing large spaces. (This is known as 'The Counter Argument'. A Counter-Counter Argument exists, but it only confuses everything).

furniture_desk.label: Desk
furniture_desk.desc: For those who aspire to life in the bureaucratic hall, even a basic starter desk can induce the feelings of power previously known only to the administrators of Ur.

furniture_fireplace.label: Fireplace
furniture_fireplace.desc: It's a place with fire. Or sometimes without the fire.

furniture_floorlamp.label: Floor Lamp
furniture_floorlamp.desc: A basic low-level provider of atmospheric downlighting. Upgrade for downlighting with wider appeal and higher aesthetic appeal.

furniture_loveseat.label: Loveseat
furniture_loveseat.desc: A loveseat for those who love seats in a moderate way. For those who really LOVE seats, upgrades to even more loveable seats are available.

furniture_roomdeco.label: Room Decoration
furniture_roomdeco.desc: To those with a layman's knowledge of art, this may look like a couple of pieces of wood roughly snailed together. But to those with their mind tuned to higher things (and the possibility of upgradiness) the true inner beauty of the piece reveals itself.

furniture_rug.label: Rug
furniture_rug.desc: Most rugs are said to pull the room together because they're aesthetically pleasing. This hardwearing floorcovering literally pulls the room together, because it has its own centre of gravity. Not really. It's just a rug.

furniture_shelf.label: Shelf
furniture_shelf.desc: The perfect shelf is longer, stronger and more attractive: this is not that shelf. It's like that shelf. It's shelf-ish. But there's nothing wrong with being a little shelfish.

furniture_sidetable.label: Side Table
furniture_sidetable.desc: A side table. For the side. The side of what, no one knows. But that's where it belongs. Not in the centre, and certainly not in the corner. Nobody puts a table in the corner.

furniture_sofa.label: Sofa
furniture_sofa.desc: The phrase "sofa: so good" is not about this sofa, which is not, essentially, a good sofa. But with a little upgrading, it could be.

furniture_stool.label: Stool
furniture_stool.desc: A deceptively simple construction offering the ability to see through walls. Small segments of wall, at any rate.

furniture_table.label: Table
furniture_table.desc: It has four legs, like a pig. It isn't a pig. It's a plain old basic table. Do not nibble it.

furniture_tabledeco.label: Tabletop Decoration
furniture_tabledeco.desc: A simple wooden table decoration? Perhaps. But squint a little, and you can see the potential that lies within it. Squint a *little* more, and it kind of looks like a chicken with a hat on. But squint any more than that and you'll get wrinkles. Stop squinting.

furniture_tablelamp.label: Table Lamp
furniture_tablelamp.desc: A basic table light, for the lighting of tables. The perfect accessory for those who long to see tables better.

furniture_walldeco.label: Wall Decoration
furniture_walldeco.desc: Some would look at this and see an empty frame. Those with more of a creative eye can see the potential that lies within it. Art is in the eye of the beholder: for a wall decoration, doubly so.

furniture_walllamp.label: Wall Lamp
furniture_walllamp.desc: For those who require a detailed, well-lit view of a small area of the wall, of anyone standing directly below the lamp, and of the lamp itself. A desirable feature.

gammas_pancakes.label: Gamma's Pancake
gammas_pancakes.desc: One mouthwatering pancake, just like Gamma used to make.

gandlevery.label: Gandlevery
gandlevery.desc: Plant with furry fern-fronds of fleetfooted goodness.

gassifier.label: Gassifier
gassifier.desc: An ergonomically correct gassifier. It can turn general vapour into much more exciting gases.

general_fabric.label: General Fabric
general_fabric.desc: A coarse fabric necessary in the construction of various basic furniture items. Attractive from a distance, face-to-fabric contact feels uncomfortably like getting up close and personal with the underside of a fox's tail.

general_vapour.label: General Vapour
general_vapour.desc: A flask of all-purpose general vapour, harvested from a Gas Plant.

girder.label: Girder
girder.desc: A solid metal material used for correctly shafting mines and supporting structures. There's some crazy rumour that if you can find a way to boil these down, you can magically create a sparkling bright orange drink out of them. But this has never been proved, and their use in construction is by far the more popular one.

glitchepoix.label: Glitchepoix
glitchepoix.desc: Combination of vegetables known as the holy quadrinity of the Glitchean cuisine.

grade_aa_earth_block.label: Urth Block
grade_aa_earth_block.desc: Marginally muddy earth of Ur, less-than-lofty loam and heavy gas from somewhat suspect origin comprise these useful building blocks.

greasy_frybread.label: Greasy Frybread
greasy_frybread.desc: A fresh chunk of butter-running-down-your-arms greasy frybread.

green.label: Green
green.desc: So fundamental, so intrinsic to the basic laws of culinary science and a healthy spleen that there was only ever one word needed to describe it: Green. So, so green.

green_eggs.label: Green Egg
green_eggs.desc: One order of fried green eggs, hold the ham.

grendalinunin.label: Grendalinunin
grendalinunin.desc: A compound made out of red, green, blue and shiny.

groddlene.label: Groddlene
groddlene.desc: A compound made out of red and green.

guano.label: Guano
guano.desc: An unobtrusive pellet from the back end of a Batterfly, Guano can be used as a fertilizer to boost the growth of Crops and Herbs, as an ingredient for Potions, or in the street-building trade.

hairball_flower.label: Hairball Flower
hairball_flower.desc: A hairy perennial. Even the thought of eating it causes feelings of antsy twitchiness.

hash.label: Hash
hash.desc: A serving of oddly satisfying hash.

hatchet.label: Hatchet
hatchet.desc: A slightly dull hatchet, useful for both dead tree-clearing and showy beard-shaving.

hearty_groddle_sammich.label: Hearty Groddle Sammich
hearty_groddle_sammich.desc: A meaty Groddle sammich with extra hot 'n' fizzy sauce for extra hot 'n' fizzy energy.

heavy_gas.label: Heavy Gas
heavy_gas.desc: A hefty flask of heavy gas. Remember to lift with your legs.

helium.label: Helium
helium.desc: One vial of premium colorless, odorless, tasteless helium. You know, the stuff that makes you sound funny.

heston_mash.label: Heston Mash
heston_mash.desc: This is not just mashed potato, this is the fanciest, zaniest, most delicious mashed potato Ur has ever ingested. And yet, really, it's still just mashed potato.

hoe.label: Hoe
hoe.desc: A garden-variety hoe. It can be used to tend weedy patches.

honey.label: Honey
honey.desc: A brimful jar of raw golden honey.

hooch.label: Hooch
hooch.desc: One jug of premium high-octane hooch.

hot_n_fizzy_sauce.label: Hot 'n' Fizzy Sauce
hot_n_fizzy_sauce.desc: One jar of potent hot 'n' fizzy sauce. This combustible comestible is packed with energy and all kinds of flaming goodness.

hot_pepper.label: Hot Pepper
hot_pepper.desc: A scoop of potentially combustible hot pepper.

hot_potatoes.label: Hot Potatoes
hot_potatoes.desc: If a glitch gives you this 'tato, drop it like it's hot. Because it is.

humbabol.label: Humbabol
humbabol.desc: A compound made out of blue and shiny.

hungry_nachos.label: Hungry Nachos
hungry_nachos.desc: Are you hungry for nachos or are nachos hungry for you? It's nacho decision to make.

ice.label: Ice
ice.desc: A nugget of purest ice, plucked with a scraper from the Nubbins of the north and ripe in readiness for sno cones, cocktail making, and icing the occasional strained glitch-groin. Basically: frozen water in pleasingly cuboid form.

irrigator_9000.label: Irrigator 9000
irrigator_9000.desc: Galvanised for your pleasure, the Irrigator 9000 offers unparalleled waterability for the constant gardener. With reinforced spout for a five-times longer life - you get what you pay for.

ixite.label: Ixite
ixite.desc: A compound made out of red, green, blue and shiny.

ixstyle_braised_meat.label: Ix-Style Braised Meat
ixstyle_braised_meat.desc: A side of rich, meaty meat, braised a la Ix.

jellisac_clump.label: Clump of Jellisac
jellisac_clump.desc: It's like your mother always said, just because it's slimy, doesn't mean it's not desirable. Even if she didn't say it, this stuff is certainly gloopy, and eminently usable. Where ooze is needed, jellisacs are your friend.

juicy_carpaccio.label: Juicy Carpaccio
juicy_carpaccio.desc: A tempting platter of juicy carpaccio with all the trimmings.

kings_of_condiments.label: King of Condiments
kings_of_condiments.desc: Otherwise known as the blandest rub in all of Ur. Meh.

knife_and_board.label: Knife & Board
knife_and_board.desc: A good knife and cutting board. They can be used to make simple foods.

krazy_salts.label: Krazy Salts
krazy_salts.desc: A vital magical ingredient, Krazy Salts should never be mistaken for normal, run of the spice-mill Pinch of Salt. For one thing, you need to save it for Potions. For the other, this Salt be KRAZY! Seriously: keep it away from sharp objects.

laughing_gas.label: Laughing Gas
laughing_gas.desc: One carefully corked container of gigglicious laughing gas.

lazy_salad.label: Lazy Salad
lazy_salad.desc: Sliced tomatoes and cheese. It doesn't get much lazier than a lazy salad.

legumes_parisienne.label: Legumes Abbassidienne
legumes_parisienne.desc: The most sophisticated, chic ways to prepare a bean: simply, classically, with a smile, a touch of flair, and a really big guillotine.

lemburger.label: Lemburger
lemburger.desc: A single-decker Lemburger with all the fixins.

lemene.label: Lemene
lemene.desc: A compound made out of red, green, blue and shiny.

lemon.label: Lemon
lemon.desc: One half of a nice pair of lemons.

lemon_juice.label: Lemon Juice
lemon_juice.desc: A tall glass of exquisitely sour lemon juice.

loam.label: Lump of Loam
loam.desc: Ah, loam sweet loam. Moist and fertile, and leagues above plain old earth, this rich, meaty chunk of ground will do any building project proud.

loomer.label: Loomer
loomer.desc: The Loomer (TM) is used to Loom thread into String, General Fabric and Rugs through a process of Loomeration so complex, only those with a deep enough understanding of the Fiber Arts II can perform the Loomering.

luxury_tortellini.label: Luxury Tortellini
luxury_tortellini.desc: It's tortellini, stuffed with extravagance and drizzled with grandeur.

mabbish_coffee.label: Mabbish Coffee
mabbish_coffee.desc: A Mabbish coffee has all the goodness of regular coffee, but gooder.

mabon.label: Mabon
mabon.desc: A compound made out of green, blue and shiny.

maburger_royale.label: Maburger Royale
maburger_royale.desc: It's not just seasoned beans in a bun smothered in stinky cheese - it's so much more than that. Oh no wait. It's just that.

meat_collector.label: Meat Collector
meat_collector.desc: A farm-grade meat collector. It works around the clock to collect meat from your piggies when you can't.

meat_gumbo.label: Meat Gumbo
meat_gumbo.desc: A bowl of thick, meaty gumbo.

mega_healthy_veggie_juice.label: Mega Healthy Veggie Juice
mega_healthy_veggie_juice.desc: A bracing tumbler of mega-healthy veggie juice.

metal_post.label: Metal Bar
metal_post.desc: A post made of metal. Good for arduous construction, securing Mineshafts, and doing daring dances on while people tuck herbs into your elasticated pants (probably not all at the same time).

metal_rock.label: Chunk of Metal Rock
metal_rock.desc: Chunky and metally, this rock, when smelted, makes Plain Metal. Boring maybe, but it's an excellent base for more ambitious alchemical experimentation.

metal_rod.label: Metal Rod
metal_rod.desc: Metal Rod, made of tin and plain metal, is not only useful for the yet unimagined construction purposes, but is also a much beloved snack of a Sloth.

metalmaker.label: Metal Machine
metalmaker.desc: A bangy, squeaky, marvellous red-hot metal machine. For the mutation of Plain Metal, Tin, Copper and Molybdenum into Metal Rods, Bars and Girders. None more metal.

mexicali_eggs.label: Mexicali Eggs
mexicali_eggs.desc: A heaping serving of bean-infused eggs.

mike_tyson_grill.label: Famous Pugilist Grill
mike_tyson_grill.desc: For grilling food. Named after the infamous gang of Potian Grillers (all called George) who roamed the countryside in days of yore, indiscriminately punching things into submission then grilling them until they were well done. Whole continents once lived in fear of the Four Georgemen of the Apocgrillypse. You, meanwhile, get to use their tribute novelty cooking item.

mild_sauce.label: Mild Sauce
mild_sauce.desc: Bland ho! It's some inoffensive mild sauce.

milk_butterfly.label: Butterfly Milk
milk_butterfly.desc: A vial of butterfly milk. It has the tingly effervescence of a thousand tiny butterfly farts.

molybdenum.label: Molybdenum Ingot
molybdenum.desc: The glint off a good piece of Molybdenum is like glimpsing into the future. That's why it's used for sophisticated and desirable electronic gadgetry.

naraka_flame_rub.label: Naraka Flame Rub
naraka_flame_rub.desc: A slightly spicy minute on the lips, a horrifically painful burning in the general area of the hips, some people say. But what do they know? Wussies.

no_no_powder.label: No-No Powder
no_no_powder.desc: Some tempting no-no powder. You know you shouldn't, but maybe just this once …

oaty_cake.label: Oaty Cake
oaty_cake.desc: A slightly dry, somewhat crumbly oaty cake.

oily_dressing.label: Oily Dressing
oily_dressing.desc: A bottle of cheap, yet strangely satisfying, oily dressing.

older_spice.label: Old(er) Spice
older_spice.desc: A handful of colorful older spice.

olive_oil.label: Olive Oil
olive_oil.desc: A bottle of top-notch olive oil, no virgins required.

onion_rings.label: Onion Ring
onion_rings.desc: Battered and fried, these are onions prepared the way Pot intended. Rumored to be popular amongst the elves. Wait, what's an elf?

onion_sauce.label: Onion Sauce
onion_sauce.desc: A jar of eye-wateringly zesty onion sauce.

orange_juice.label: Orange Juice
orange_juice.desc: A surprising glass of orange juice.

ore_grinder.label: Grinder
ore_grinder.desc: A sturdy, no-nonsense grinder. Harness its awesome power to grind rocks (and those rock-like barnacles) into alchemical elements.

pad_tii.label: Pad Tii
pad_tii.desc: Tii has not heard of this dish yet. Chances are it would not approve. Do not tell Tii. Please.

papl_upside_down_pizza.label: Pineapple Upside-Down Pizza
papl_upside_down_pizza.desc: A plate of exotically topsy-turvy pizza.

peat.label: Block of Peat
peat.desc: After eons of sitting in the bog -- condensing, compacting and quietly conducting Peaty business -- this dense stinky block should be used to boost building projects.

pepitas.label: Roasted Pepitas
pepitas.desc: Crunchy, nutty, seeds pulled from a pumpkin ready roasted (it must be that hot knife you used). May cause a roasted pumpkin to grow in your stomach. No, not really. Will cause you to feel smug about your healthy snacking choices, though.

pi.label: Pi
pi.desc: The recipe for Pi was described in ancient times by Alphimedes of Salatu, who also purportedly invented a heat ray for attacking the Rook. (If the heat ray ever existed, it has long since been lost.) It was later improved upon by Ludolph the Cerulean, named for his bright blue skin. Ludolph gave a Pi to several of the giants. Tii immediately stated that Pi was irrational. Pot, on the other hand, declared this to be the best pie he’d ever eaten - transcendental, in fact.

pick.label: Pick
pick.desc: A relatively sturdy pick, without which mining cannot be done. A plain pick takes care of business, but it's not designed to last.

piggy_egg.label: Piggy Egg
piggy_egg.desc: An egg seasoned with special porcine spices to hatch a Piglet.

piggy_feeder.label: Piggy Feeder
piggy_feeder.desc: A piggy feeder is a must-have device for lazy farmers. It will feed your pigs while you are away.

pinch_of_salt.label: Pinch of Salt
pinch_of_salt.desc: A tiny pinch of very salty salt.

plain_bubble.label: Plain Bubble
plain_bubble.desc: A common, ordinary, plain bubble harvested from Bubble Tree.

plain_crystal.label: Plain Crystal
plain_crystal.desc: It shimmers, it glitters, and it's worth a good few currants, but you can't help but think that for a crystal, it's a little bland. Not that you're complaining.

plain_metal.label: Plain Metal Ingot
plain_metal.desc: Sure, this metal is plain, but with the aid of Alchemical Tongs, Alchemy II and a secret blend of elemental ingredients, more exciting metal materials can be made.

plank.label: Plank
plank.desc: A plain wooden plank with many uses.

potato_patty.label: Potato Patty
potato_patty.desc: One potato, mashed and fried in a pleasing disc shape.

potcorn.label: Potcorn
potcorn.desc: Pot corn is a regular corn made to pop because its kernels have a hard moisture-sealed hull and a dense starchy interior. This allows pressure to build inside the kernel until an explosive "pop" results.

potians_feast.label: Potian's Feast
potians_feast.desc: The greatest, most magnificent, energy-filled, Pot-approved combination of nourishment. A fitting dish to make or eat for any serious Potian.

potion_amorous_philtre.label: Amorous Philtre
potion_amorous_philtre.desc: A sensual - and highly infectious - blend of natural ingredients that stimulate the positive mood-memory receptors of the Glitchate Brain. Smells like macaroons.

potion_ancestral_spirits.label: Ancestral Spirits
potion_ancestral_spirits.desc: Steadies the nerves and steels the soul against the onset of Ancestral Nostalgia.

potion_animal_youth.label: Potion of Animal Youth
potion_animal_youth.desc: Animals, anxious about aging and longing for childhood, can be soothed by application of this potion: the only effusion with the proven ability to turn back time.

potion_avatar_large.label: Embiggenifying Potion
potion_avatar_large.desc: "A noble potion embiggenifies the smallest glitch" reads the tiny label on this tinier bottle. Embiggenifies, you ask? "Yes" say the voices of the ancients, drifting to you through the sour aftersmell of the potion, "Embiggenifies. It is a perfectly cromulent word." For creating an embiggenifying cloud wherever you choose.

potion_avatar_small.label: De-Embiggenifying Potion
potion_avatar_small.desc: When poured on the floor, it releases a very pleasant scent (a strange mixture of cherry tart, custard, pineapple, roast turkey, toffee, and hot buttered toast) and a cloud causing people to feel most curious, like they're shutting up like a telescope or some such.

potion_charades.label: Charades Potion
potion_charades.desc: A classic 'Parlour Potion', this benefits those surrounding the quaffer more than the quaffer themselves - but only if they can guess the word that unlocks the effect.

potion_chris.label: Door Drink
potion_chris.desc: The most bewildering of all potions, the dark alchemical secrets brewed into this potent brew can produce (and destroy) mysterious doors to far-off lands. You'll find yourself leaping from place to place, never knowing where the next leap may lead you.

potion_elixir_of_avarice.label: Elixir of Avarice
potion_elixir_of_avarice.desc: A natural blend that increases one's appetite for Quoins. Dosage: effective up to one potion per day.

potion_favor.label: Draught of Giant Amicability
potion_favor.desc: Causes the quaffer to smell like stardust, hot sauce, whiskers on kittens and several other of the Giants' favourite things, thus granting a modicum of favor from the Giant the potion happens to be most amicable with. Shake up to three times a day to shift Giant affinity. Do not exceed one quaff a day.

potion_garden_clear.label: Liquid Super-Hoe
potion_garden_clear.desc: A bag full of hoes might be able to clear your whole garden, a bottle of Liquid Super-Hoe has more clearing power than any common old hoe-bag. One drop will clear all the plots that can be cleared from the nearest garden.

potion_garden_fertilize.label: Dung-Kicker Drops
potion_garden_fertilize.desc: One squirt of Dung-Kicker Drops spreads fertilizer over all fertilizable plots in a garden (no extra guano necessary), leaving you free to enjoy more pleasant-scented parts of the gardening experience.

potion_garden_harvest.label: Manyharvest Cordial
potion_garden_harvest.desc: Like a delicate tornado, one drop of Manyharvest Cordial will gently gather all ripe crops from the nearest garden (while,  like a twister filled with generosity, giving you all the usual 'super-harvest' bonuses).

potion_garden_plant.label: Seed-Dibber Libation
potion_garden_plant.desc: Just one dose of this patented Seed-Dibber Libation will plant every available plot of the nearest garden with your chosen seed (if you have enough seeds available). Save your fingernails for pretty things, eh?

potion_garden_water.label: Soak-All Solution
potion_garden_water.desc: A single drop of Soak-All Solution (a tiny bottle filled with matter wetter than wet itself) will water every plot in the nearest garden with only a flick of the wrist.

potion_keycutter_tonic.label: Keycutter Tonic
potion_keycutter_tonic.desc: With a sharp metallic taste and acidic fizz, this is a concoction so strong that the fumes given off it when quaffed carve keys into the shape of other keys.

potion_rainbow_juice.label: Rainbow Juice
potion_rainbow_juice.desc: Where is the end of the rainbow? Apparently, in this bottle. Warning: may produce curious disruptive effect on air around it. Thus the term, 'Anti-Gravity Rainbow'.

potion_rook_balm.label: Rook Balm
potion_rook_balm.desc: Originally marketed under the less classy RUK-B-GONE, this potion, post-rebrand, does precisely the same job - emergency full healing of any rooked critter or tree.

potion_trantsformation_fluid.label: Trantsformation Fluid
potion_trantsformation_fluid.desc: A tree-reassignment liquor, capable of soaking into the roots of any tree or plant and silently, smelllessly, "almost" harmlessly rearranging its DNA.

potion_tree_poison.label: Tree Poison
potion_tree_poison.desc:
Thick glass conceals a dark truth: the death sentence for five trees. But really, since the inevitable broom of death clears the way for new life, isn't it actually just "a life sentence for five NEW trees"? 
No, it's mainly just tree poison.

potion_tree_poison_antidote.label: Tree Poison Antidote
potion_tree_poison_antidote.desc: Tree antidote: the only known reprieve for the mostly dead tree (there's a big difference between "mostly dead" and "all dead"). Contains five sips at the last chance saloon for five lucky trees.

potoxin.label: Potoxin
potoxin.desc: A compound made out of red, green and blue.

pottine.label: Pottine
pottine.desc: So wrong. But so, so right.

powder_of_mild_fecundity.label: Powder of Mild Fecundity
powder_of_mild_fecundity.desc: The dust in this jar of reasonably fecund powder gets up the noses of piggies, butterflies and chickens (up to a point, there is only so much dust) and causes them to shed small amounts of their edibles everywhere.

powder_of_startling_fecundity.label: Powder of Startling Fecundity
powder_of_startling_fecundity.desc: This jar of high-potency powder gets under the skin of piggies, chickens and butterflies (up to a limit, one dose can only irritate a certain number of animals) and causes them to fecund their edibles all OVER the place.

precious_potato_salad.label: Precious Potato Salad
precious_potato_salad.desc: Potato salad, traditionally an affordable staple at Glitchen birthdays, is now fit for fancy dinners and lavish banquets with the addition of the particularly precious Trump Rub.

proper_rice.label: Proper Rice
proper_rice.desc: A steaming bowl of slightly sticky rice.

pumpkin.label: Pumpkin
pumpkin.desc: One plump and thick-skinned pumpkin. Perfect for carving, mulching, munching, and, in times of need, for using as a carriage drawn by tamed gerbils.

pumpkin_ale.label: Pumpkin Ale
pumpkin_ale.desc: All the refreshment of beer combined with the autumnal savoury heft of pumpkin. Then combined with cinnamon. For no reason anyone can decipher.

pumpkin_pie.label: Pumpkin Pie
pumpkin_pie.desc: When people use the phrase 'as nice as pie', they are, in fact, talking about this pie. What goes into it? Fresh pumpkin, crispy pastry, spicy spices, and a big dollop of love. (That's an attitude rather than a hidden ingredient, before you start feeling nauseous).

red.label: Red
red.desc: Some things are so basic, so fundamental that they only need one word to describe what they are. This perfect blend of tomato, onion and butterfly milk sums up the essence of red.

rice.label: Rice
rice.desc: A pot of freshly made rice.

rich_tagine.label: Rich Tagine
rich_tagine.desc: A steaming pot of zesty, slow-cooked tagine.

rookswort.label: Rookswort
rookswort.desc: An exotic bud with a pleasantly lasting aftertaste of danger and chaos.

rubemycin.label: Rubemycin
rubemycin.desc: A compound made out of red, green, blue and shiny.

rubeweed.label: Rubeweed
rubeweed.desc: A deceptively dull green shoot filled with lucky sap.

salmon.label: Pocket Salmon
salmon.desc: It's like salmon, but in your pocket! Pocket Salmon! The handy friendly fish-at-your-fingertips that's always ready to go! Why settle for boring old underwater catch-me-if-you-calmon-salmon when you could have the ever-accessible, always-dependable, never-stinky always-yummy Pocket Salmon instead! POCKET SALMON! [TM. Always read the label. Terms and conditions apply]

salmon_jaella.label: Salmon Jaella
salmon_jaella.desc: An assortment of fresh Salmon from Jal, Rice, Legumes and veggies thrown together into a dish Jal-loving Glitchen identify themselves by.

saucepan.label: Saucepan
saucepan.desc: A saucepan is a must-have item for making sauces.

savory_smoothie.label: Savory Smoothie
savory_smoothie.desc: A savory smoothie. It sticks to your ribs and doesn't let go.

scraper.label: Scraper
scraper.desc: Wielding  only this hardy flat-edged blade, a song in their heart and a will to succeed, anyone can boast a backpack of Barnacles or a pocket full of Ice. Why that glitch might want a clacking bag and potentially wet pants is not the problem of the scraper. Scraper just scrapes.

secret_sauce.label: Secret Sauce
secret_sauce.desc: An enigmatic jar full of mysteriously yummy secret sauce.

shovel.label: Shovel
shovel.desc: An essential for anyone that calls a spade a shovel, this simple tool masterpiece can be used to harvest Peat, dig for dirt (well, Earth), and occasionally land a juicy piece of Loam.

silvertongue.label: Silvertongue
silvertongue.desc: A blue sparkly bloom of joy.

simple_bbq.label: Simple BBQ
simple_bbq.desc: Some hot meat with tangy sauce.

slow_gin_fizz.label: Slow Gin Fizz
slow_gin_fizz.desc: A low and lazy slow gin fizz.

smelter.label: Smelter
smelter.desc: Extracting purest metal from even the dullest chunk of Metal Rock, this classic Smelter is the second step to creating all manner of exciting secondary metals. (Learning Smelting is step one.)

snack_pack.label: Snack Pack
snack_pack.desc: An apple, some cheese, and a couple of pickles. Not quite a meal, but it'll do until dinner.

snail.label: Snail
snail.desc: Part-screw, part-nail (and managing to combine the less useful parts of both), snails are the product of a Sloth getting private time with metal rods.

sneezing_powder.label: Sneezing Powder
sneezing_powder.desc: A potentially troublesome jar of sneezing powder.

sno_cone_blue.label: Blue Sno Cone
sno_cone_blue.desc: A delicious, refreshing Blue Sno Cone with a tangy hit of iMG. Blended to perfection using ice, hooch, and the very finest elemental additives and preservatives, it tastes exactly what the the concept of blue should taste like. And a little like raspberry, weirdly.

sno_cone_green.label: Green Sno Cone
sno_cone_green.desc: A bright green blend of ice, hooch and elements make a drink the color of days when spring is born, or nights when the northern lights perform. Packed with a modest hit of iMG, winter cannot fade it. Mainly because it's 40% elemental additives and preservatives.

sno_cone_orange.label: Orange Sno Cone
sno_cone_orange.desc: A chillingly refreshing bright Orange Sno Cone, with a medium amount of iMG. A perfect blend of Ice, Hooch, and elemental additives and preservatives, it is the epitome of an orange drink. Not orange the fruit, that is, orange the colour. It's more of a concept.

sno_cone_purple.label: Purple Sno Cone
sno_cone_purple.desc: A refreshing and delicious purple Sno Cone. A sophisticated blend of Ice, Hooch and elemental additives and preservatives. Now you too can get all the social frisson of Purple but with none of the nutritional or mental expansion benefits (contains considerable iMG, though).

sno_cone_rainbow.label: Rainbo Sno Cone
sno_cone_rainbow.desc: A rainbo in Sno Cone form, eating this blend of all the other Sno Cones makes your tongue tingle, your sinuses snigger and your spine spontaneously decide to go on a tropical vacation to Shimmyville. Warning: Contains gloriously high levels of iMG.

sno_cone_red.label: Red Sno Cone
sno_cone_red.desc: A tongue-tingling spine-shiveringly Red Sno Cone. A seamless blend of Ice, Hooch, and a secret blend of elemental additives, preservatives, iMG and raw energy that make you feel slightly, though not to any copyright-infringing extent, like you may have wings.

sparkle_powder.label: Sparkle Powder
sparkle_powder.desc: A shimmery jar of sparkle powder.

sparkly.label: Chunk of Sparkly
sparkly.desc: It's a pleasantly twinkly chunk of sparkly!

spice_mill.label: Spice Mill
spice_mill.desc: A basic spice mill for converting basic allspice into other more exciting spices.

spicy_grog.label: Spicy Grog
spicy_grog.desc: A tall glass of exceedingly spicy grog.

spinach.label: Spinach
spinach.desc: Hearty green spinach. It's strong to the finich.

spindle.label: Spindle
spindle.desc: In the mists of time, storytellers spoke of  a magical spindle that could be used to spin starlight into downy threads to weave into a cloak of invisibility. But it's not this spindle. This is just a spindle. It's used to turn fibers into thread. But that other one sounds amazing, right?

splendid_spindle.label: Splendid Spindle
splendid_spindle.desc: The ancients whispered of the spindle of Cosma that could spin the very fibres of air into cloths of heaven, enwrought with golden and silver light; blue and dim and dark cloths of night and light and the half-light. This is not that spindle. But it is really quite a good spindle, and it lasts longer than the other kind of spindle.

spriggase.label: Spriggase
spriggase.desc: A compound made out of red, green and blue.

stock_sauce.label: Stock Sauce
stock_sauce.desc: As plain and every day as a woman laughing while eating salad, no one even things about Stock Sauce any more. Perhaps they should.

string.label: String
string.desc: This is String. In theory, it can be used for constructing fabric, rugs, and other basic furniture items. It is a pretty good theory.

super_scraper.label: Super Scraper
super_scraper.desc: Replacing the rustic charm of the bestselling original Scraper with super-streamlined barnacle-busting ice-nubbin-bustin' action, the highly desirable Super Scraper offers five times the lasting power for slightly-more-than-five-times the price. What can I say? You pay for convenience (and natty design).

super_veggie_kebabs.label: Super Veggie Kebab
super_veggie_kebabs.desc: Chunks of assorted vegetables on a fun pointy stick!

swank_zucchini_loaf.label: Swank Zucchini Loaf
swank_zucchini_loaf.desc: A good loaf can be made out of anything. A great loaf is made from Zucchini and talks about how rich it is.

sweet_n_sour_sauce.label: Sweet 'n' Sour Sauce
sweet_n_sour_sauce.desc: Is it sweet? Is it sour? It's both! It's sweet 'n' sour sauce!

swing_batter.label: Swing Batter
swing_batter.desc: After roughly chopping with a knife, this batter is not mixed, blended or whisked, but swung at the end of the arm. Swing batter, batter batter swing, batter (as they say).

tangy_noodles.label: Tangy Noodles
tangy_noodles.desc: A generous serving of zesty, lemony tangy noodles.

tangy_sauce.label: Tangy Sauce
tangy_sauce.desc: A large jar of gloppy tangy sauce.

tasty_pasta.label: Tasty Pasta
tasty_pasta.desc: A bowl of extra-long noodles with rich bolognese sauce.

test_tube.label: Test Tube
test_tube.desc: If you want to turn elements into compounds, you need a handy-dandy test tube. It's totally tubular.

thread.label: Thread
thread.desc: Thread, spun from Fox tail fibers, and essential in the Loomeration of String. Easily lost (but easily picked up again), smells faintly of Fox bottom.

tiite.label: Tiite
tiite.desc: A compound made out of red and blue.

tincturing_kit.label: Tincturing Kit
tincturing_kit.desc: Anyone who wants to beef up the benefits of herbs or create ingredients for powerful potions would do well to avail themselves of this basic Tincturing Kit and the Tincturing skill. As the name suggests, it is perfect for making tinctures. And no use at all for anything else.

tinkertool.label: Tinkertool
tinkertool.desc: Are you the DIY type who likes to repair your own tools? The nitpicky type who likes to craft their own gear from scratch? Then a Tinkertool is a very handy thing for you to have.

trump_rub.label: Trump Rub
trump_rub.desc: So called because it trumps all the other rubs in expense, flavour, and the ability to be extremely annoying (if you get it in your eye).

urfu.label: Urfu
urfu.desc: A moist beige flaccid matter, imbued with the ability to suck up other flavours.

vegmageddon.label: Vegmageddon
vegmageddon.desc: No rich urth-born root or brave brassica can survive the searing heat of a Pugilist Grill. It is a slow, vicious end for them. But justified, they say, in the name of 'Healthy Living'.

wall_segment.label: Wall Segment
wall_segment.desc: On its own, it would just fall over. But among a house and other Wall Segments, it becomes the building block of home expansions. Useful for widening and adding floors to houses.

watering_can.label: Watering Can
watering_can.desc: A stainless-steel 5-gallon watering can. It can be used to water plants, trees, and crops.

wavy_gravy.label: Wavy Gravy
wavy_gravy.desc: One pint of wavy gravy. It's so good, you'll eat it with a spoon.

white_gas.label: White Gas
white_gas.desc: A vial of pristine white gas.

whortleberry_jelly.label: Whortleberry Jelly
whortleberry_jelly.desc: One jar of homemade whortleberry jelly, made from the pulverized remains of a thousand quivering whortleberries.

wicked_bolognese_sauce.label: Wicked Bolognese Sauce
wicked_bolognese_sauce.desc: A small jar of wicked bolognese sauce, on spaghetti or on its own for a meaty treat.

wood_post.label: Wood Post
wood_post.desc: If you squint and look hard, you can almost see the joins where the Planks were put together to make Boards, and the Boards tirelessly hewn into a Post. But in its glorious finished form, you can't see the Planks for the Post. Or something.

woodworker.label: Woodworker
woodworker.desc: How much wood would a Woodworker work if a Woodworker could work wood, you say? Glad you asked. It's four. Four Planks make a Board, four Boards a Post, four posts make a Beam. So how much wood would a Woodworker work if one could work wood? Four.

yellow_crumb_flower.label: Yellow Crumb Flower
yellow_crumb_flower.desc: Like having a tiny garden full of sunshine. How clever!

zillene.label: Zillene
zillene.desc: A compound made out of green, blue and shiny.
